settings.question: Are the listed prices inclusive of VAT?
settings.answer:
The listed prices for all service packages do not include 8% VAT.
VAT will be applied and added to the total payment in accordance with current regulations.

settings.question: If my ads are performing well, should I use the maximum number of ad posts each month?
settings.answer: Not necessarily. The maximum number of ad posts is provided to help you test and compare different content to find what works best. If your current ads are delivering good results, there’s no need to make unnecessary changes.

settings.question: How can I make the payment?
settings.answer: You can make the payment to PiLiVerse via bank transfer. We will start running your campaign as soon as the payment is received.

settings.question: How is the billing cycle calculated?
settings.answer: The payment is calculated from the moment the advertising campaign starts running.

settings.question: Can I cancel the service before the billing cycle ends?
settings.answer: For the Mini Facebook Ads service, we do not support early cancellation before the billing cycle ends.

settings.question: Can I change my service plan?
settings.answer: You can upgrade your service plan at any time during the current billing cycle. However, downgrading to a lower plan can only be done after the billing cycle ends.
